\label {sol: if the underlying relation on a preordered vector space is a partial order then we get the cone condition}Clearly, the right-hand side belongs to the left-hand side so we must show the other inclusion. So, let $x \in V^+ \cap (-V^+)$. This means that $x \leq 0$ and $0 \leq x$ so the antisymmetry of the order implies that $x = 0$.
